summary: Iteration 11 (weakness analysis + score export) tested end-to-end. Backend: 15/15 pytest passing — admin /api/admin/analysis returns 7 students globally, proctor /api/proctor/analysis returns 5 students school-scoped (SMA Nusantara 1 only, no leak of Rizki/Maya); all three CSV endpoints (scores/recap/items) return text/csv with correct Indonesian headers including Numerasi/Literasi/Kompetensi/Tren; question competency field persists on create/update; template CSV includes competency column; CSV import stores competency. critical_code_review_comments: analysis.py build_report runs 4 large DB fetches per request without any caching; on large datasets each admin/proctor page hit re-computes everything. Consider caching by (scope,timestamp) or precomputing on submit for scale.
routes_proctor.reports_csv uses StreamingResponse+iter([buf]) while routes_admin uses Response(content=...). Minor inconsistency, harmless.
In WeaknessReportView.jsx the download() catch swallows the real error object (bare `catch {}`); adding console.error would help future debugging.
